ef3031f58a:
nīlaṣaṇḍapramōkṣēṇa amāvāsyāṁ tilōdakaiḥ ।
varṣāsu dīpakaiśchaiva pitr̥̄ṇāmanr̥ṇō bhavēt॥ mahābhāratē 13-188-70 ॥
akṣayaṁ nirvyalīkaṁ cha dānamētanmahāphalam ।
asmākaṁ paritōṣaścha akṣayaḥ parikīrtyatē॥ mahābhāratē 13-188-71 ॥
amāvāsyāṁ tu yē martyāḥ prayachchhanti tilōdakam ।
pātramaudumbaraṁ gr̥hya madhumiśraṁ tapōdhana ।
kr̥taṁ bhavati taiḥ śrāddhaṁ sarahasyaṁ yathārthavat॥ mahābhāratē 13-188-78 ॥
hr̥ṣṭapuṣṭamanāstēṣāṁ prajā bhavati nityadā ।
kulavaṁśasya vr̥ddhistu piṇḍadasya phalaṁ bhavēt ।
śraddadhānastu yaḥ kuryātpitr̥̄ṇāmanr̥ṇō bhavēt॥ mahābhāratē 13-188-79 ॥
f32023fc7d:
bhrūṇahatyādikaṁ chāpi pāpaṁ jahyādasaṁśayam ।
ya imaṁ śuchiradhyāyaṁ paṭhētparvaṇi parvaṇi॥ mahābhāratē 1-1-295 ॥
adhītaṁ bhārataṁ tēna kr̥tsnaṁ syāditi mē matiḥ ।
yaśchainaṁ śr̥ṇuyānnityamārṣaṁ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ॥ mahābhāratē 1-1-296 ॥

f4f5094c4c:
muhūrtārdhāvaśiṣṭāyāṁ dvādaśyāṁ pāraṇaṁ prati।
chintayāmāsa dharmajñō dvijaistaddharmasaṅkaṭē॥ bhāgavatē 9-6-26 ॥
brāhmaṇātikramē dōṣō dvādaśyāṁ yadapāraṇē।
yat kr̥tvā sādhu mē bhūyādadharmō vā na māṁ spr̥śēt॥ bhāgavatē 9-6-27 ॥

f7649f7c1b:
pitr̥̄narchya pratipadi prāpnuyātsvagr̥hē striyaḥ ।
abhirūpaprajāyinyō darśanīyā bahuprajāḥ॥ mahābhāratē 13-134-10 ॥
striyō dvitīyāṁ jāyantē tr̥tīyāyāṁ tu vājinaḥ ।
chaturthyāṁ kṣudrapaśavō bhavanti bahavō gr̥hē॥ mahābhāratē 13-134-11 ॥
pañchamyāṁ bahavaḥ putrā jāyantē kurvatāṁ nr̥pa ।
kurvāṇāstu narāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṁ bhavanti dyutibhāginaḥ॥ mahābhāratē 13-134-12 ॥
kr̥ṣibhāgī bhavēchchhrāddhaṁ kurvāṇaḥ saptamīṁ nr̥pa ।
aṣṭamyāṁ tu prakurvāṇō vāṇijyē lābhamāpnuyāt॥ mahābhāratē 13-134-13 ॥
